hero.title: Home Assistant AI Digest
hero.copy: Turn Home Assistant warnings, unavailable entities, stale sensors, and delivery failures into a private daily briefing you can act on.
hero.privacy: Secrets are sent only to the local backend and displayed as masks after validation.

onboarding.title: Guided onboarding

fields.privacyAccepted: I accept that selected data may be sent to the AI provider to generate reports.

onboarding.schedulePrivacyNotice: We will save this schedule and privacy level before running the first digest. Secrets stay referenced and masked.
onboarding.missingSetupToken: The setup assistant bootstrap key is missing. Provide it through a private channel before completing first run.
onboarding.firstDigestNotice: The setup is ready. Validation will save the settings and queue the first digest.

explanations.homeAssistant: We need Home Assistant access to detect incidents. The URL and token are validated before continuing.
explanations.aiProvider: AI is required to explain incidents. Choose a provider and add its key; it is never shown in full.
explanations.notifier: Notifications are optional. You can use on-screen reports and configure Telegram later.
explanations.schedule: The schedule controls when reports are generated.
explanations.privacy: Privacy controls what context may be sent to AI and how long it is retained.
explanations.schedulePrivacy: The schedule controls when reports are generated. Privacy controls what context may be sent to AI and how long it is retained.

progress.success: Settings saved. The first digest is queued.
progress.retry: Setup could not be completed. Review the message and retry.

errors.haUrl: Enter a valid Home Assistant URL.
errors.settingsPersistenceUnavailable: Settings could not be saved before the first digest. Check the secure backend connection and try again.
errors.privacyAccepted: Confirm how data will be used before continuing.
errors.missingSetupToken: Validation is unavailable: SETUP_TOKEN is missing. Configure the bootstrap token in the backend and reload the page.
